title: Suspension of Gauth Eye
summary: Alchemical extract used for Elixir of Battlemage's Power.

fields.Extract: Combine 3 Gauth Eyestalks to make one Suspension of Gauth Eye.
fields.Brew: Combine this extract with any Sublimate to make Elixir of Battlemage's Power.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
